info.name: App Analytics – Mobile Ingestion API
info.description:
# App Analytics – Mobile Ingestion API

Official API reference for the **React Native analytics SDK**. Every request the mobile app must make to report analytics is documented here.

## Base URL
All endpoints are mounted under `/api/v1`.

```
{{base_url}} = https://mahindraappanalytics.crmlvoice.com/api/v1
```

## Authentication
**There is currently NO authentication on these endpoints.** They are protected only by rate limiting. The `{{jwt_token}}` environment variable and the optional `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}` header are included for forward-compatibility — the backend ignores them today. Do **not** block SDK integration waiting for auth.

## Response envelope
Every response uses a consistent shape.

**Success**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { } }
```

**Error**
```json
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "..." } }
```

## How analytics map to endpoints
The backend exposes only **6 real endpoints**. Conceptual mobile events map onto them:

| Mobile concept | Real call |
|---|---|
| Identify / register user | `POST /ingest/identify` |
| Session start (carries device info) | `POST /ingest/session/start` |
| Session end | `POST /ingest/session/end` |
| Screen view (with dwell time) | `POST /ingest/screen` |
| App open / close, login/logout, button click, feature usage, **API call / performance**, **crash**, **error** | `POST /ingest/events` (batch) |
| Health probe | `GET /health` |

> **Device information** is sent as fields on `session/start` (platform, appVersion, osVersion, deviceModel, networkType, location). There is no separate `/device` endpoint.
>
> **Crash logs & performance timings** are sent as items in the `POST /ingest/events` batch using `eventType` = `crash` / `app_startup` / `api_call` / `error`, plus an optional `metrics` object.

## Event batching
`POST /ingest/events` accepts an array of **1–50 events**. The SDK should buffer events client-side and flush them in batches. Each event needs a **client-generated unique `eventId`** (a UUID) — duplicate `eventId`s are silently skipped, making retries safe.

## Idempotency & duplicates
- `session/start` is idempotent per `sessionId` (returns the existing session).
- `events` de-duplicates on `eventId` (safe to retry a batch).
- `identify` is an upsert on `userId`.

## Rate limiting
Ingestion endpoints are limited to **200 requests / minute** (per IP, configurable). Exceeding it returns `429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. Batch your events to stay well under this.

## Timestamps
All timestamps are **ISO-8601 UTC** strings, e.g. `2026-07-07T10:20:30Z`. If omitted, the server stamps `now`.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness probe. Use to verify connectivity before the SDK starts flushing events.

request.description:
**Why:** Confirms the analytics backend is reachable.

**When to call:** Optionally on app start / before first flush, or in a debug screen.

**Auth:** None.

**Mandatory fields:** none.  **Optional fields:** none.

**Duplicates:** Always safe.

**Status codes:** `200 OK`.

item.name: User Identity
item.description: Create / update the mobile user profile. Upsert keyed on `userId`.

request.description:
**Why:** Registers or updates the user profile so all downstream sessions/events attribute to a known user.

**When to call:** On login / signup, and whenever the profile changes. Safe to call once per app launch after auth.

**Auth:** None.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `userId` | string | ✅ | Stable unique id for the user. |
| `name` | string | ⬜ | Display name. |
| `email` | string | ⬜ | Must be a valid email if provided. |
| `platform` | enum | ⬜ | `ios` \| `android` \| `web`. |

**Duplicates:** Idempotent upsert on `userId`. First call sets `firstSeenAt`; later calls update `lastActiveAt`.

**Expected response:** `200 OK` with the full user document.

**Status codes:** `200`, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `429`. Also accepts the org/geography hierarchy (zone/state/ao/dealer/branch/tm/designation/mobile/doj/starId) that powers the Geography and Dealer/AO/TM analytics dashboards — all optional, only the fields you send are updated.

response.name: 400 Validation Error

request.description:
**Why:** Records one login instance. Distinct calendar days (UTC) with a login drive the frequent (>20 days) / occasional (5–19) / low (1–4) / no-login (0) classification on the Geography and Dealer/AO/TM dashboards.

**When to call:** Once per successful login (in addition to session/start, not instead of it).

**Auth:** None.

**Duplicates:** Safe to call multiple times per day — loginDays only increments the first time a given UTC day is seen; totalLogins increments every call.

**Status codes:** 200, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, 429.

item.name: Sessions
item.description: App-session lifecycle. Device information is captured here on `start`.

request.description:
**Why:** Opens an analytics session and records the device/context it runs in. This is also where **device information** lives (no separate `/device` endpoint).

**When to call:** On app foreground / cold start, once per session. Generate a fresh `sessionId` (UUID) each time.

**Auth:** None.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | ✅ | Client-generated unique id. |
| `userId` | string | ✅ | Owner of the session. |
| `startTime` | ISO-8601 | ⬜ | Defaults to server `now`. |
| `platform` | enum | ⬜ | `ios` \| `android` \| `web`. |
| `appVersion` | string | ⬜ | e.g. `2.4.0`. |
| `osVersion` | string | ⬜ | OS version. |
| `deviceModel` | string | ⬜ | e.g. `Samsung Galaxy S24`. |
| `networkType` | enum | ⬜ | `wifi` \| `cellular` \| `offline` \| `unknown`. |
| `location` | object | ⬜ | `{ country, city, lat, lng }`. |

**Duplicates:** Idempotent — a repeated `sessionId` returns the existing session (`201`), never a duplicate.

**Expected response:** `201 Created` with the session document.

**Status codes:** `201`, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `429`.

**Why:** Closes the session and lets the server compute its duration (`endTime - startTime`).

**When to call:** On app background / termination, once per session.

**Auth:** None.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | ✅ | The session being closed. |
| `userId` | string | ✅ | Owner. |
| `endTime` | ISO-8601 | ⬜ | Defaults to server `now`. |

**Duplicates:** Safe. If the `sessionId` is unknown the response is `200` with `data: null`.

**Expected response:** `200 OK` with `{ sessionId, duration }` (duration in ms).

**Status codes:** `200`, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `429`.

item.name: Screen Tracking
item.description: Per-screen dwell tracking, denormalized for fast screen analytics.

request.description:
**Why:** Records a screen visit with dwell time. Powers Top Screens, avg time on screen, and funnel analytics.

**When to call:** When the user **leaves** a screen (so you know the dwell), send the entry/exit pair. Alternatively send on entry and patch later — the SDK's choice; the simplest reliable pattern is to record on exit.

> ⚠️ **Field names:** the backend uses `entryTime` / `exitTime` / `duration` (ms) — **not** `enteredAt` / `leftAt` / `timeSpent`.

**Auth:** None.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | ✅ | Session the visit belongs to. |
| `userId` | string | ✅ | User. |
| `screenName` | string | ✅ | Route/screen identifier, e.g. `HomeScreen`. |
| `entryTime` | ISO-8601 | ⬜ | Defaults to `now`. |
| `exitTime` | ISO-8601 | ⬜ | When the user left. |
| `duration` | integer (ms) | ⬜ | Dwell in ms; if omitted, computed from entry/exit. |

**Duplicates:** Each call creates a new visit row — do **not** resend the same visit.

**Expected response:** `201 Created` with the screen-visit document.

**Status codes:** `201`, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `429`.

item.name: Event Tracking (Batch)
item.description:
All discrete analytics events flow through a single **batch** endpoint: `POST /ingest/events`.

Send an array of **1–50** event objects. Each needs a **client-generated unique `eventId`** (UUID). Duplicate `eventId`s are skipped → retries are safe.

**Common event fields**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | string | ✅ | Unique per event (UUID). |
| `sessionId` | string | ✅ | Session it belongs to. |
| `userId` | string | ✅ | User. |
| `eventType` | enum | ✅ | `app_open`, `app_close`, `login`, `logout`, `screen_view`, `screen_exit`, `button_click`, `navigation`, `api_call`, `error`, `crash`, `app_startup`, `custom`. |
| `eventName` | string | ✅ | Human-readable name. |
| `screenName` | string | ⬜ | Screen context. |
| `timestamp` | ISO-8601 | ⬜ | Defaults to `now`. |
| `properties` | object | ⬜ | Arbitrary key/values. |
| `duration` | number (ms) | ⬜ | For timed events. |
| `errorMessage` | string | ⬜ | For `error` / `crash`. |
| `apiEndpoint` | string | ⬜ | For `api_call`. |
| `statusCode` | number | ⬜ | For `api_call`. |
| `metrics` | object | ⬜ | Perf timings: `{ loadTimeMs, startupTimeMs, responseTimeMs }`. |

Each request below shows the **exact single-event payload** for one conceptual event so the SDK can copy it. In production, buffer several and send them together (see *Batch – Multiple Events*).

request.description:
**Why:** Marks the app entering the foreground.

**When:** On app launch / resume, alongside `session/start`.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `timestamp`.

**Duplicates:** De-duplicated on `eventId`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Marks the app entering background / termination.

**When:** On app background, alongside `session/end`.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Records a successful login. (Profile creation itself is done via `POST /ingest/identify`.)

**When:** After authentication succeeds.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `properties`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Records a logout.

**When:** When the user signs out.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** A lightweight screen-view event (distinct from the richer dwell record at `POST /ingest/screen`). Include `metrics.loadTimeMs` to feed screen-load performance analytics.

**When:** On screen focus. For dwell/time-on-screen analytics prefer `POST /ingest/screen`.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `screenName`, `properties`, `metrics.loadTimeMs`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Generic UI interaction tracking. Put interaction context in `properties`.

**When:** On taps/clicks you want to measure.

> Note: the backend has no `eventCategory` field — put category/section inside `properties`.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `screenName`, `properties`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Track domain/feature usage that doesn't fit a standard type. Use `eventType: "custom"` and a descriptive `eventName`.

**When:** Whenever a tracked feature is used.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `screenName`, `properties`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Enquiry Creation, tracked for both Salesman and Sales Manager/Coordinator roles (split by the designation set on /ingest/identify).

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Enquiry Review, tracked for both Salesman and Sales Manager/Coordinator roles.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Enquiry Follow-up, tracked for both Salesman and Sales Manager/Coordinator roles.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Product Guide, tracked for the Salesman role group only.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Village Visit, tracked for the Salesman role group only.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Booking, tracked for the Sales Manager/Coordinator role group only.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feature Usage dashboard (Priority 3) — Delivery, tracked for the Sales Manager/Coordinator role group only.

**Mandatory:** eventId, sessionId, userId, eventType, eventName. **Optional:** screenName, properties, timestamp.

**Response:** 201 → { inserted, total }.

**Why:** Feeds API-response-time performance analytics. Populate `metrics.responseTimeMs` (and `apiEndpoint`/`statusCode`).

**When:** After each network call you want to measure.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `apiEndpoint`, `statusCode`, `duration`, `metrics.responseTimeMs`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Feeds app-startup-time performance analytics via `metrics.startupTimeMs`.

**When:** Once per cold/warm start, after first frame is interactive.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `metrics.startupTimeMs`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Records a crash for crash-count and crash-free-rate analytics.

**When:** In your global JS error / native crash handler, buffered and flushed on next launch (a crashing app may not flush immediately).

> `stackTrace`, `appVersion`, `deviceModel`, `fatal` have no dedicated columns — nest them under `properties`. Use `errorMessage` for the top-line message.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `screenName`, `errorMessage`, `properties`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** Records a non-fatal handled error (distinct from `crash`).

**When:** In catch blocks / error boundaries for recoverable failures.

**Mandatory:** `eventId`, `sessionId`, `userId`, `eventType`, `eventName`. **Optional:** `screenName`, `errorMessage`, `properties`, `timestamp`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.

**Why:** The recommended production pattern — buffer events on-device and flush **1–50** per request to minimize network + stay under the rate limit.

**Duplicates:** Any event whose `eventId` was already stored is skipped; the rest still insert. Response `inserted` may be less than `total`.

**Response:** `201` → `{ inserted, total }`.
